name: Procrastination: The Root Causes
instructions: Notice which specific tasks you delay most, and what feeling comes up right before you avoid them.
Common root causes include fear of failure, unclear next steps, and tasks that feel too big -- identify which applies to your delayed task today.
Address the root cause directly: break down an unclear task, or lower the stakes of a feared one by aiming for "done," not perfect.
Watch today's video for more on why procrastination happens.
